name: Kuroinu 2 ~In'yoku ni Somaru Haitoku no Miyako, Futatabi~
original_name: 黒獣2 ～淫欲に染まる背徳の都、再び～
source:
In this country, all desires are affirmed.

Located at the west of the Serenus continent, it's the city of lust and depravation, the "Cuntry" Negramstia.

More than a hundred years after its foundation, this country has now reached the peak of prosperity and decadence. Posessing an overwhelming "charm" power, the great adulteress empress Radmila rules over Negramstia with her powers. The empress pass her days indulging in pleasure and in the neighboring countries "people hunts" are performed as a pleasure tribute, opening a chain of pillage and tragedy.

Meanwhile, many countries that won't stand such inmorality any longer, unite and name themselves as the "Holly Alliance" to stand up against Negramstia. The force of the allied army overwhelm the Cuntry, and they manage to successfully corner Negramstia in an encirclement.

But before the allied army stood one man. The one rumored to be the second coming of the founding father the "King Mercenary" Vult, the Black Dogs Knights' captain Dyrek Rondo. Following Radmila's order, he pursues the allied army surrounding the Cuntry to destroy them but, the real ambition in Dyrek's heart is to "take over the throne". Not only aiming for the beatiful maidens of the allied army, but also empress Radmila, in order to obtain everything, Dyrek ignites his ambition.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/15th/kuro_2/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
在這個國家，所有慾望都得到肯定。

塞雷努斯大陸西部坐落著慾望與墮落之城——「淫國」內格拉姆斯提亞。

建國一百多年後，這個國家達到了繁榮與頹廢的頂峰。擁有壓倒性「魅惑」力量的偉大淫蕩女皇拉德米拉，以自己的力量統治內格拉姆斯提亞。女皇日日沉溺於快樂，鄰國則將「獵來的俘虜」作為快樂貢品，掀起一連串掠奪與悲劇。

與此同時，許多再也無法容忍這種不道德行為的國家聯合起來，自稱「神聖聯盟」，向內格拉姆斯提亞宣戰。聯軍壓倒了淫國，成功將內格拉姆斯提亞逼入包圍圈。

然而，聯軍面前站著一個男人。他被傳為建國之父、「傭兵王」沃爾特的第二次降臨——黑犬騎士團團長戴雷克．朗多。他遵照拉德米拉的命令出擊殲滅圍攻淫國的聯軍；但戴雷克心中的真正野心，是「奪取王座」。他不僅瞄準聯軍中的美麗少女，也瞄準女皇拉德米拉。為了得到一切，戴雷克點燃了野心。

（譯自[url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/15th/kuro_2/story.html]官方網站[/url]）
